description: Enhanced boundary and logical-path coverage for the email value object: an explicitly empty primary-recipient list is still a valid construction (renders an empty 'to'); multi-element cc/bcc lists are semicolon-joined; a single custom header and a three-header set exercise the header-count and key-sort logic with more than the two headers the native suite covers; and the missing-required-field precedence is probed by supplying only a strict prefix of the mandatory fields so the FIRST absent field in validation order is the one reported.

cases.expected_output:
from=a@b.c
to=
cc=
bcc=
subject=S
body=B
custom_header_count=0

from=a@b.c
to=x@y.z;p@q.r
cc=c1@x.y;c2@x.y
bcc=b1@x.y;b2@x.y
subject=S
body=B
custom_header_count=0

from=a@b.c
to=x@y.z
cc=
bcc=
subject=S
body=B
custom_header_count=1
custom_header.X-Only=1

from=a@b.c

bcc=
